description: This file is a shell script for testing the behavior of 'git reset --patch' commands, including various options and scenarios. It defines test cases to validate the correctness of interactive resets with patch mode in Git.

methods.name: set_and_save_state
methods.description: Sets up the testing environment by initializing a repository, creating and committing files, and saving the current state.

methods.name: save_head
methods.description: Saves the current HEAD position for later verification.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the commit timestamp to ensure unique commit times.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit on the current branch.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executes the commands, and checks for successful completion.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Feeds lines of input to simulate user input during interactive commands.

methods.name: verify_saved_state
methods.description: Verifies that the specified file's state matches the expected state.

methods.name: verify_state
methods.description: Verifies the current state of files in the repository matches expectations.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail, used to test error conditions.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks if the output contains specific strings, validating expected output.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the working directory and file states for testing.

methods.name: verify_saved_head
methods.description: Verifies that the HEAD has not moved from its saved position.
